purpose: Frozen gradual context/model expansion of native composition diagnostic; no hidden-feature claim
context_matching: Identical generator seed, phases, amplitudes, offset and global t across contexts; each context ends on full32/16 periods
normalization: Every condition MSE divided by SAME per-bundle mixed variance (a*a+b*b)/2
oracle_composition: f(pure_phi)+f(pure_psi)-known exact offset, not f(offset); known input labels provide component decomposition
primary_pass: mean >=0.05 common-mixed-variance MSE, lower bootstrap95%CI >0, fixed global Holm6 p<0.05; vanished effects at longer context reported as conditions
secondary: All3modelpair native mixed-MSE gaps at each3contexts; fixed global Holm9, paired64seed bundles

inference.test: paired seed sign-flip, two-sided plus-one; requires symmetry/exchangeability; bootstrap fixed native predictions

descriptive: Per model/context untouched-phase change, component amplitude/phase suppression, oracle sum decomposition; raw and common-mixed-variance units labeled

compute.pause: check elapsed between model/context blocks; stop starting new blocks at10min and ask parent

selection: No fitting, checkpoint changes, period changes, model tuning, or adaptive controls. Save protocol before new inference.
